explication: The AWS SDK for Go v2 is a client library for invoking AWS service APIs. Its documented user workflow is to load configuration, construct a service client, call an operation, and receive typed output or an error. Generated operation code defines request and response shapes and configures middleware; the excerpted service operations also show pagination and waiter helpers. The tree identifies protocol, signing, retry, and HTTP transport packages as runtime layers. Internal wiring beyond the excerpts is not asserted; dashed links mark likely but unverified execution relationships.
